public.package_balances.name: package_balances
public.package_balances.definition: SELECT p.id AS package_id, p.user_id, COALESCE(sum(l.delta), 0::bigint)::integer AS balance FROM message_packages p LEFT JOIN message_ledger_entries l ON l.package_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id

public.expert_referral_balances.name: expert_referral_balances
public.expert_referral_balances.definition: WITH ledger_totals AS ( SELECT expert_referral_ledger_entries.expert_id, COALESCE(sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor), 0::numeric)::bigint AS net_minor, COALESCE(- sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = ANY (ARRAY['reservation'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind, 'release'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind])), 0::numeric)::bigint AS reserved_minor, COALESCE(sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = 'reward_grant'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind), 0::numeric)::bigint AS granted_minor, COALESCE(- sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = 'spend'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind), 0::numeric)::bigint AS spent_minor, COALESCE(- sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = 'expiry'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind), 0::numeric)::bigint AS expired_minor FROM expert_referral_ledger_entries GROUP BY expert_referral_ledger_entries.expert_id ), grant_remaining AS ( SELECT g_1.id, g_1.expert_id, g_1.expires_at, COALESCE(sum(a.amount_minor), 0::numeric)::bigint AS remaining_minor FROM expert_referral_reward_grants g_1 LEFT JOIN expert_referral_ledger_allocations a ON a.reward_grant_id = g_1.id WHERE g_1.expires_at > transaction_timestamp() GROUP BY g_1.id, g_1.expert_id, g_1.expires_at HAVING sum(a.amount_minor) > 0::numeric ), grant_expiry AS ( SELECT grant_remaining.expert_id, min(grant_remaining.expires_at) AS nearest_expiry_at FROM grant_remaining GROUP BY grant_remaining.expert_id ) SELECT e.id AS expert_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.net_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS available_credit_minor, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.reserved_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS reserved_credit_minor, g.nearest_expiry_at, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.granted_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS lifetime_granted_minor, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.spent_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS lifetime_spent_minor, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.expired_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS lifetime_expired_minor, GREATEST(- COALESCE(l.net_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS debt_minor FROM experts e LEFT JOIN ledger_totals l ON l.expert_id = e.id LEFT JOIN grant_expiry g ON g.expert_id = e.id
